checks.name: Tracking is idempotent and keeps the first record
Only the FIRST consuming tick counts, so catch-up steps cannot rewrite it
Only the FIRST affected packet counts as the response
A packet cannot be bound before the input was consumed
Invalid identities and values are ignored instead of creating records
Retention is bounded while the cumulative counter keeps counting
Pending reports consumed input that never reached a packet
This ledger does not duplicate the existing receipt-to-submit measurement
